name: Sueca (Spain)
description: Red field with a white Latin cross, the letters SV, HE, C and A in white in the four quarters.
history: The local flag is of proportions 2:3, of satin, scarlet or red, with a white Latin cross and in the four angles of the cross, also in white, the inscription SV–HE–C–A. This flag has been in immemorial use by the authorities of the city and is based on the ensigns of the Knights Hospitaller, but it was not officially adopted until 13 November 2002.

features.role: Latin cross with its crossbar towards the hoist
